title: Which one fails?
examObjective: Converting between output types and data types using DataWeave
prompt: Every script writes `application/csv`. **One fails.** Which one?

options:
%dw 2.0
output application/csv
---
[{ sku: "A", w: 1 }, { sku: "B", w: 2 }]

%dw 2.0
output application/csv
---
[{ sku: "A", dims: { w: 1, h: 2 } }]

explanation.approach: A CSV cell holds a single value. A nested Object has no cell to go in, so the writer fails. Flatten the row first. A single Object is accepted and written as one row.

snippets.label: The one that fails
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/csv
---
[{ sku: "A", dims: { w: 1, h: 2 } }]

snippets.label: A single Object is one row
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
write({ sku: "A", w: 1 }, "application/csv", { header: false })
snippets.note: Shown through `write` so the text is visible.
